# ChartKit.io

> ChartKit.io is the documentation and product site for React Native Chart Kit, a composable charting library for React Native. The public `react-native-chart-kit` package includes MIT-licensed v2 charts, SVG rendering defaults, interaction primitives, themes, and migration-friendly APIs. Chart Kit Pro adds commercially licensed chart workflows such as candlebar, radar, realtime bar, combo charts, export APIs, and optional Skia rendering.

Use Chart Kit for React Native dashboards, time-series trends, category comparisons, proportions, progress, and calendar activity. Charts render locally in the app. The public HTTP API serves documentation only. No API key is needed. Read a chart page before writing code; preserve the legacy root import for existing screens unless a migration is requested. Use modern charts from `react-native-chart-kit/v2` for new work.

## When to use Chart Kit

- [Agent instructions](https://chartkit.io/agent-instructions.md): Task selection, how to call the library and documentation API, and public versus Pro boundaries.
- [Chart Kit developer guide](https://chartkit.io/developers.md): Installation, live sandbox examples, authentication, documentation API, and official CLI.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://chartkit.io/openapi.json): Typed read-only documentation operations for function calling.
- [Documentation API](https://chartkit.io/api/v1/docs): List exact public page paths and Markdown URLs.

## Overview

- [Home](https://chartkit.io/index.md): Product overview, supported charts, feature highlights, and plan comparison.
- [Documentation](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native.md): Main React Native Chart Kit documentation hub.
- [Quickstart](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/getting-started/installation.md): Install `react-native-chart-kit`, `react-native-svg`, and render a first chart.
- [Contributing](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/getting-started/contributing.md): Set up the repository and run local development checks.
- [Troubleshooting](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose blank charts, Expo compatibility, gesture behavior, and migration issues.

## Installation

- [Public package quickstart](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/getting-started/installation.md): Install the free MIT package for public chart families.
- [Pro installation](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/pro-installation.md): Install `@chart-kit/pro` next to `react-native-chart-kit` for licensed Pro chart workflows.
- [Pricing and plans](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/pricing.md): Compare Free, Pro, and Enterprise scope.

## Public Charts

- [Line chart](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/line.md): Show trends, forecasts, null gaps, selection, and changes over time.
- [Area chart](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/area.md): Show filled trends where magnitude and direction both matter.
- [Bar chart](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/bar.md): Compare category totals, rankings, grouped bars, stacked bars, and horizontal bars.
- [Pie chart](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/pie.md): Render segmented pie charts with legends, labels, and tap selection.
- [Donut chart](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/donut.md): Render donut charts with center labels, legends, and tap selection.
- [Progress chart](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/progress.md): Show circular progress values with labels and accessible output.
- [Contribution heatmap](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/contribution-heatmap.md): Render calendar-style activity and intensity data.
- [Legacy charts](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/legacy.md): Old root-import chart examples for the legacy-compatible API.

## Pro Charts

- [Candlebar chart](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/candlebar.md): Inspect OHLC price movement, wicks, volume, and crosshair readouts.
- [Radar chart](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/radar.md): Compare KPI profiles, benchmarks, and capability scores.
- [Realtime bar chart](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/realtime.md): Stream rolling bar windows with realtime chart APIs.
- [Combo chart](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/combo.md): Compare bars and lines together in one chart.
- [Export APIs](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/export.md): Export Pro charts as PNG or SVG for reports, sharing, and background generation.

## Guides

- [Themes](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/themes.md): Share colors, typography, presets, and renderer choices across chart surfaces.
- [Accessibility](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/charts/accessibility.md): Make chart screens understandable to screen readers and assistive technologies.
- [Migration from v1](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/migration/from-v1.md): Move existing screens toward the modern v2 API.
- [Prop mapping](https://chartkit.io/docs/react-native/migration/prop-mapping.md): Map legacy chart props to modern v2 equivalents.

## Packages

- [`react-native-chart-kit`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-native-chart-kit): Public MIT React Native chart package.
- [`@chart-kit/core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chart-kit/core): Public MIT chart geometry and shared core package.
- [`@chart-kit/svg-renderer`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chart-kit/svg-renderer): Public MIT SVG renderer package.
- [`@chart-kit/pro`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chart-kit/pro): Publicly installable commercial Pro chart package.
- [`@chart-kit/skia-renderer`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chart-kit/skia-renderer): Commercial optional Skia renderer package for Pro workflows.
